scientific_integrity: One mathematical claim assessed for proof correctness, comparison to accessible literature, and value. Computational verification is finite; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Sufficient short-stride range only; large even differences and cases where every prime divisor of the base minus one divides the difference are not covered. The general conjecture remains open outside the proved region.
title: Sharp anti-Niven progressions for short even strides in odd bases
